changelog: feat: a second front end, served at /beta by the same backend, so UI work can continue while the production console at / keeps running customer jobs. It is a separate folder (frontend-beta/) with no build step and no shared code, mounted before the SPA catch-all in main.py — a mistake in it cannot break the Vite bundle, fail deploy_dev.sh, or change a single production route. Everything that READS is live against the real API: job list, step timeline built from step_history, the log exactly as the pipeline wrote it, the settings snapshot including dbPath_requested vs dbPath, licence entitlements and the installed database list. Job submission is deliberately NOT wired up in this cut. Also adds GET /version, which nothing exposed before. Three things the beta gets right that the production UI does not, and which are therefore bugs to port back: each marker carries its own primers, so a 12S job can no longer be shown 16S primers; assignSpecies files are never offered in the taxonomy-database picker and a file that is missing from disk is never the default selection; and a run paused at a checkpoint sorts above the running ones instead of below them.
